newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends easier vs dlr at 192.25/35.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends easier vs dlr at 192.25/35.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed weaker against a surging dollar but little changed against the currency basket on Tuesday in the interbank foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The forint closed at 192.25/35 against the U.S. unit compared with an opening of 191.25/30 and a midday level of 192.02/07.
The forint remained close to the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level, and dealers saw no reason why the forint should leave it.
"It was a dull market with the forint close to the (resistance level) of the intervention band," said Peter Benda of Citibank. "I don't see any change in the pattern."
The Hungarian unit floats within a 4.5 percent-wide NBH intervention band against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
